chunks: He answered: "Peace be on you. I will seek forgiveness of my Lord for you. He has been gracious to me."
ai.seo_question: What did Maryam say when she received the news of Jesus' birth?
ai.summary: In this verse, Maryam responds to the angelic announcement with the greeting 'Peace be upon you,' a phrase Shia scholars often interpret as a response to the angel's salutation or a declaration of tranquility in the face of divine decree. She attributes her status to Allah's 'Hafiy' (Ever-Gracious/Kind), emphasizing that her honor stems not from her own merit but from God's intimate benevolence, a concept central to Shia understandings of the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt.
